findings.title: Upright phone settings hide the Audio and Accessibility tabs off-screen with no sign that more tabs exist
findings.detail: A player holding the phone upright sees four tabs that end cleanly at the right margin and nothing that says the strip scrolls. Anyone looking for Audio or Accessibility, the players who most need to find it, has no cue that those pages exist. Landscape (settings@phone) at least shows a clipped 'ACCESSIB' as a hint; upright shows none.
findings.evidence: settings@phone-upright controls: TOUCH [16,87,65,44], CONTROLS [83,87,92,44], VIDEO [312,87,61,44] ends at x=373; AUDIO starts at [375,87,62,44], past the 374 px content edge of a 390 px viewport. settings-hud@phone-upright has ACCESSIBILITY at [376,87,121,44], also fully outside. settings@phone shows the clipped tab at [751,10,125,44].
findings.fix: On upright phones wrap the tabs onto two rows, or keep the sideways scroll but always leave half a tab cut at the right edge plus a fade or chevron so the strip reads as scrollable.

findings.title: Desktop health and ammo readouts drop far below 4.5:1 when the ground or a wall behind them is bright
findings.detail: The corner readouts rely on a soft bottom scrim and a text shadow, so over a pale fence or sand the small labels wash out and even the big health number loses its edge. The phone layout already puts the same readouts on flat ink plates and measures above 12:1. Same on range-hud@desktop and, more mildly, match-hud@desktop.
findings.evidence: contrast.md, countdown@desktop: 'Health' 13 px p50 1.76 / p10 1.32; '100' 60 px bold p50 4.38 / p10 1.97 (needs 3); 'M4A1' 16 px bold 4.12 / 2.56; 'auto' 13 px 4.14 / 2.95; '/ ∞' 22 px 4.69 / 3.86. range-hud@desktop: 'auto' 3.15 / 2.39, 'M4A1' 3.49 / 2.39. match-hud@desktop p10: Health 3.43, M4A1 3.59, auto 3.53. Phone plates: Health 12.75, auto 13.68.
findings.fix: Give the desktop corners the same flat ink plate the phone readouts use (or deepen the bottom scrim to at least 72% under the text block) so the p10 ratio clears 4.5:1 on any map.

findings.title: The countdown's mode name and number sit unplated on the sky and measure under 2:1
findings.detail: At the start of every match the mode name and the 3-2-1 number are white text straight over cloud, held up only by a shadow. The goal line right below them is on a plate and reads fine, so the two most important words of the moment are the weakest on screen. Phone has the same layout with slightly better luck in the background.
findings.evidence: contrast.md, countdown@desktop: 'Team deathmatch' 16 px bold p50 1.81 / p10 1.62 (needs 4.5); number '2' 51.84 px bold p50 2.03 / p10 1.89 (needs 3). countdown@phone: 'Team deathmatch' [359,70,126,16] 3.9 / 1.79; '2' [413,94,18,32] 3.34 / 2.82.
findings.fix: Extend the goal line's plate upward to hold the mode name and the number, or put a soft scrim behind the whole countdown block.

findings.title: The match result headline ('Defeat', 'Orange wins') floats on the sky with no plate
findings.detail: The one line that tells the player whether they won is the only text on the end screen without a surface behind it. Grey 'Defeat' over a pale sky is the weakest; the orange team line survives on its size and shadow. The same headline on end-panel@phone measures lower still, and end-vote@desktop shows a grey 'Victory' over cloud.
findings.evidence: contrast.md, end-vote@phone: 'Defeat' 22 px bold declared 9.47, measured p50 1.5 / p10 1.46; '▲ Orange wins' 32 px bold declared 8.74, measured p50 1.47 / p10 1.23 (large text needs 3). end-panel@phone: 1.22 and 1.15. Every line inside the panel below passes.
findings.fix: Move the result headline into the top of the end panel, or give it its own ink plate or a top-edge scrim like the bottom one used for the HUD.

findings.title: The red 'ENEMY' ping label is under 2:1 against walls and foliage
findings.detail: A pinged enemy is marked by a red triangle and the word ENEMY in 13 px red directly on the world. Over green siding the word nearly vanishes, and a red/green pair is the worst case for the most common colour-vision deficiencies. The distance under it, in the text colour, measures more than twice as high on the same background.
findings.evidence: contrast.md, scoreboard@desktop: 'Enemy' [966,480,47,13] 13 px bold, declared 6.25, measured p50 1.88 / p10 1.68 (shadow only); '54 m' [975,495,28,13] 13 px p50 4.51 / p10 4.21. The mark keeps a triangle and a word, so it is not colour-only.
findings.fix: Put the ping label on a small ink plate the way ally name tags are ('Rook', 'Ember' are on plates), keeping the red for the triangle and the plate's text.

findings.title: The phone's first-match hint is set at 13 px and the Announcer toast shows through its plate
findings.detail: The line that teaches a new phone player how to move and look is at the small label size, while the same hint on desktop is 16 px. It is also drawn on top of the Announcer toast, whose text ghosts through behind it, so two sentences share one strip. The 13 px hint also appears on score-lines@phone and range-hud@phone, and scoreboard@phone leaves the toast showing under the panel edge.
findings.evidence: match-hud@phone .dom.json: hint 'Move with your left thumb. Drag the right side to look' [287,290,309,13] at 13 px; 'Announcer' [284,294,63,13] and 'Team deathmatch. The range is hot.' [357,294,205,13] at 13 px in the same band. DESIGN.md calls both the hint line and a toast 'one body-size line' (16 px); TYP-01 asks 14 px for phone body text.
findings.fix: Set the hint line and toast at the body step (16 px) on phones and give them separate slots, or hold the toast until the hint has gone.

findings.title: Touch choices are stacked 1 to 2 px apart instead of 8 px
findings.detail: Every target is at least 44 px tall, but stacked segment rows and the settings tabs touch each other, so a thumb landing on the seam picks the neighbour. In the mode picker three 44 px rows sit directly on top of one another. Same pattern on royale@phone-upright, the settings tabs on phone and phone-upright, and the pause list on pause@phone.
findings.evidence: bot-lobby@phone-upright: TEAM DEATHMATCH [17,604,178,44], FREE-FOR-ALL [196,604,178,44], OUTPOSTS [17,649,178,44], CHARGE [196,649,178,44], GUN GAME [17,694,356,44]: 1 px between rows and columns. royale@phone-upright: SOLOS/DUOS/TRIOS at x 17/136/255, width 118: 1 px. settings@phone tabs TOUCH [136,10,69,44] | CONTROLS [207,10,96,44]: 2 px. pause@phone RESUME [16,111,812,54] | LOADOUT [16,171,812,54]: 6 px. DESIGN.md asks for 8 px or more.
findings.fix: On touch give stacked segment rows and tabs an 8 px gap (or make each row 52 px tall with the hit area inset), and space the pause rows by 8 px.

findings.title: HUD size is locked on phones, where the HUD labels are already at the 13 px floor
findings.detail: New idea: a text-size control should not be withdrawn on the device where text is physically smallest. On a phone the HUD size slider is disabled with a note that the screen keeps its own layout, so a player who finds the labels too small has no way to enlarge them. Same on settings-hud@phone-upright.
findings.evidence: settings-hud@phone: 'HUD size' input [32,325,708,44] disabled, note 'A screen this narrow keeps its own layout.' [32,303,247,13]. settings-hud@phone-upright: input [32,439,254,44] disabled. match-hud@phone HUD labels 'Health' [325,332,39,13], 'auto' and '/ ∞' are 13 px; values 22 px.
findings.fix: Keep the phone layout fixed but let the slider scale the text inside the plates and toasts (for example 100 to 130%), or offer a 'Larger HUD text' switch on phones.

findings.title: The button that holds keyboard focus when a screen opens looks the same as an unfocused one
findings.detail: The footer advertises arrows to move and Enter to select, but on opening the screen the focused button carries no ring, fill or bar, so a keyboard or pad player cannot tell what Enter will do. Seen on the focused BACK here, START on bot-lobby@desktop, DONE on loadout@desktop and TRY AGAIN on error@desktop. The main menu and pause do show a lit row.
findings.evidence: profile@desktop .dom.json marks BACK [56,1022,125,44] as focused; cropped side by side it is identical to the unfocused BACK on settings@desktop. bot-lobby@desktop focused START [1604,1008,260,58] matches the unfocused CHECK AGAIN on royale@desktop. theme.ts does define rings for :focus-visible and [data-pad-focus], so the style exists but is not applied to focus set by script after a pointer click.
findings.fix: When a screen opens and moves focus by script, mark the target with data-pad-focus (or call focus with focusVisible) so the existing signal ring shows; clear it on the next pointer move.

findings.title: Play Online on a sideways phone opens with focus on a Name field hidden under the footer
findings.detail: The screen takes focus into the Name text field by itself, and on a landscape phone that field sits behind the footer row, so the focused control is invisible and a keyboard may rise over the page. Only the 'Your details' heading shows above the buttons. online@phone-upright also opens with the field focused, there visible.
findings.evidence: online@phone .dom.json: focused input [34,362,776,46] in a 390 px tall viewport; footer BACK [16,338,125,44], CHECK AGAIN [149,338,171,44], SERVER OFFLINE [327,338,501,44] cover y 338 to 382. online@phone-upright: input [34,476,322,46] focused. DESIGN.md: on touch 'a text field never takes the focus by itself'.
findings.fix: On touch do not auto-focus the Name field; focus the footer's primary action (or nothing), and make sure the body's scroll area ends above the footer so the field can be scrolled fully into view.

findings.title: The Practice Range stats panel covers the top of the 'Health' label
findings.detail: In the range the TTK and distance panel is stacked straight above the health readout and its bottom edge cuts through the word 'Health', leaving half-height letters. The label is already the weakest text in that corner.
findings.evidence: range-hud@desktop: stats panel about [56,722,204,246] ends at y=968; 'Health' label box [56,964,39,13] starts at y=964, a 4 px overlap, and the cropped screenshot shows the word sliced. 'M4A1' on the same shot measures p10 2.39.
findings.fix: Anchor the range panel 8 px above the health block (bottom at y 956 or less), or move it to the left edge mid-height.

findings.title: Desktop sliders are 20 px tall targets
findings.detail: Every range slider in settings is a 20 px tall strip, under the 32 px a mouse target should have, so grabbing the thumb takes care, more so for anyone with a tremor or a low-precision pointer. The main menu's Name field is also sampled at 21 px tall.
findings.evidence: settings-hud@desktop: 'HUD size' [660,227,284,20], 'Arm length' [660,667,284,20], 'Gap' [660,724,284,20], 'Thickness' [660,781,284,20]. settings-touch@desktop: 'Touch sensitivity' [660,227,284,20]. main-menu@desktop 'Name' input [1643,77,206,21]. MENU-03 asks about 32 px with a mouse; the phone sliders are 44 px.
findings.fix: Give range inputs a 32 px tall hit area on desktop (padding or min-height on the input, track drawn centred) and let a click anywhere in the row's control column move the thumb.
